description: Cancel ONE post that is still scheduled. Instagram, TikTok and Snapchat (and Soclo generally) offer no unpublish, so a post that is already publishing or live cannot be removed through Soclo and this refuses rather than attempting it. Pass confirm: true only after the owner has agreed to cancel that exact post; without it this returns a preview and cancels nothing. Needs publish:post.

confirm.description: true only after the owner agreed to cancel that exact post. Omit or pass false to get a preview instead: nothing is cancelled and nothing else is fetched.

name: soclo_posts_cancel
title: Cancel a scheduled post
